ns2:section.sectionText: Meets in 109 English. The course will cover Schmitt's political theology, the concept of the Katechon, and the jurisprudential philosophy of history in Nomos of the Earth. The Jewish writers who directly respond to Schmitt and who be studied include Walther Benjamin, Ernst Bloch, Leo Strauss, Hannah Arendt, Jacob Taubes, and Jacques Derrida. The conflict between Schmitt and these thinkers focuses on the relationship between justice and violence. Meets with JS501.
